- Description: Envoy: vault auth-scan incident response
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/546
  
  Details:
  Root-cause investigation of an active scan/fuzz attack against /auth/send-challenge: read app/auth_routes.py, forensically traced journalctl logs across two service names to find the real pattern (pentest-labeled payloads, CRLF injection probe, ~2000-char overflow string), RDAP-checked the source IP. Created #vault-auth-scan-incident Discord channel and drove the investigation. Independently verified Sophia's privilege-escalation finding (create_jwt defaulting to author_role=governor) by reading auth.py/auth_routes.py directly. Diagnosed and fixed the disk-space blocker myself (box was 100% full/0 free, blocking all of Sophia's write tools) - used direct SSH access where her tooling failed, identified ~120GB of stale /tmp scratch clones, freed 26GB, unblocking the fix. Reviewed both candidate PRs (#546 deletion, #547 hardening) in full diff, decided #546 (deletion of dead/vulnerable endpoints) was the right fix over hardening unused code, and approved the merge.
